issues: UI primary flow test fails: after accepting the policy, the app stays on a loading state and never displays the dashboard empty screen. The logs show runtime errors 't is not a function' in the UI. This indicates a bug in the navigation or component rendering (likely a wrong import or missing component). The dashboard never renders, causing the acceptance test step expecting "No activity yet" to time out.

Accessibility check fails: the app renders ActivityIndicator components without an accessible name, violating aria‑progressbar‑name. Add an appropriate accessibilityLabel or accessibilityHint to all ActivityIndicator / ProgressBar components (e.g., <ActivityIndicator accessibilityLabel="Loading dashboard" />).

Accessibility check fails: the bottom tab bar renders links inside a role="tablist", which is not allowed. Each tab button must have accessibilityRole="tab" (or tabBarAccessibilityRole) and proper accessibilityState. Update BottomTabNavigator screenOptions to set tabBarAccessibilityRole: "tab" and ensure each tab button renders a Pressable with accessibilityRole="tab" and accessibilityState={{ selected }}.

Accessibility check fails: color contrast for tab icons/text (e.g., #007aff on white background) does not meet WCAG AA ratio. Adjust the theme colors for tab icons and text to use higher contrast colors (e.g., a darker primary or a different secondary color) or increase font size, ensuring a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for UI elements.
feedback: The acceptance tests all pass, but the static validation reveals critical failures in both functionality and accessibility. Fix the runtime error that prevents the dashboard from rendering after policy acceptance, ensure all ActivityIndicators have accessible labels, correct the tab navigation roles to satisfy ARIA requirements, and adjust theme colors to meet contrast standards. Once these issues are resolved, re‑run the tests and static validation.
